title: SQL Server Agent job
why: Express has no SQL Server Agent (Microsoft editions table: SQL Server Agent = No for Express in 2022 and 2025), so this job is created but never runs.
fix: Save the job body as job.sql and schedule `sqlcmd -S .\SQLEXPRESS -E -i job.sql` with Windows Task Scheduler or cron.

title: Database Mail
why: Express has no Database Mail (editions table: Database mail = No for Express), so alerts sent from T-SQL are never delivered.
fix: Send the alert from the application or from the scheduled script that runs sqlcmd (check its exit code).

title: Backup compression
why: Express does not support backup compression (editions table: Backup compression = No for Express); BACKUP ... WITH COMPRESSION fails, so the backup is not written.
fix: Remove COMPRESSION from the WITH list and compress the .bak afterwards (gzip, 7-Zip or Compress-Archive).

title: Database size over the Express cap
why: Express caps a relational database at 10 GB on SQL Server 2022 and 50 GB on SQL Server 2025 (data files; the log does not count). Past the cap, inserts fail.
fix: Set MAXSIZE to the cap (10GB on 2022, 50GB on 2025) so growth stops with a clear error, archive old rows, or keep this database on Standard.

title: max server memory above the Express buffer pool
why: Express uses at most 1,410 MB of buffer pool per instance, whatever max server memory says.
fix: EXEC sp_configure 'max server memory (MB)', 2048; -- 1,410 MB buffer pool + headroom; size the box for the Express cap

title: Transparent data encryption (TDE)
why: Express has no TDE (editions table: Transparent data encryption = No for Express); the statement fails and the database stays unencrypted.
fix: Encrypt the disk instead (BitLocker on Windows, LUKS on Linux) or use Always Encrypted for the sensitive columns (available in Express).

title: Change data capture
why: Express has no change data capture (editions table: Change data capture = No for Express).
fix: ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET CHANGE_TRACKING = ON (CHANGE_RETENTION = 2 DAYS, AUTO_CLEANUP = ON); -- Change tracking is in Express

title: Log shipping
why: Express has no log shipping (editions table: Log shipping = No for Express), and it needs SQL Server Agent to copy and restore.
fix: Back up the log on a schedule (sqlcmd + Task Scheduler/cron), copy the file, and restore WITH NORECOVERY on the standby server.

title: Availability group
why: Express has no Always On availability groups, not even basic ones (editions table: Basic availability groups = No for Express).
fix: Scheduled backup + restore to a second server, or keep the high-availability database on Standard (basic availability groups).

title: Resource Governor
why: Express has no Resource Governor (editions table: Resource governor = No for Express).
fix: Drop the pool/workload group script; Express already limits itself to the lesser of 1 socket or 4 cores.

title: Agent service in ConfigurationFile.ini
why: This unattended setup file configures the SQL Server Agent service, which Express does not run.
fix: Delete the AGTSVC* lines from ConfigurationFile.ini and schedule jobs with Task Scheduler.

title: Paid or non-production edition still set here
why: MSSQL_PID / PID chooses the edition. Developer editions are for non-production use only; Standard and Enterprise need a licence (Standard: $3,945 per 2-core pack, SQL Server 2022 list price).
fix: MSSQL_PID=Express (containers) or remove PID= and install from the Express media (ConfigurationFile.ini).

title: SQL Server image with no MSSQL_PID
why: The mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server image defaults to the Developer edition when MSSQL_PID is not set (Docker Hub page), which is licensed for non-production use only.
fix: Add MSSQL_PID=Express to the environment of this service.

title: More CPU than Express will use
why: Express uses the lesser of 1 socket or 4 cores; cores above 4 given to this container are paid for and idle.
